script:
control-agent-server llm preset deepseek
EMPTY=$(control-agent-server conversation start --tools none --no-autotitle --print-id)
CID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --tools none --no-autotitle --print-id)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json '{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F07_ONE"}],"run":false}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json '{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F07_TWO"}],"run":false}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --expect 200 --check . eq 5
E0=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query limit=100 --field items.0.id)
E1=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query limit=100 --field items.1.id)
E2=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query limit=100 --field items.2.id)
E3=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query limit=100 --field items.3.id)
E4=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query limit=100 --field items.4.id)
